request.style: English, male solo voice with deep choir, acoustic guitar, cello, drums, percussion, somber and tense mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The word came to Jeremiah from the Lord
After Zedekiah made a covenant in the land
To proclaim liberty for all the people found
Set free your Hebrew slaves so none held down

[Verse]
All the officials and the people obeyed
They set the male and female slaves at bay
But afterward they changed their minds and turned
Took back the freed and forced the laboring burned

[Chorus]
So now I proclaim liberty for you
Liberty to the sword plague and famine too
I will make you a horror to the earth
Because you broke the covenant in your birth

[Verse]
I made a covenant with your fathers of old
When I brought them out from the house of toil
At the end of seven years let them go free
But they did not listen to what I said to be

[Chorus]
So now I proclaim liberty for you
Liberty to the sword plague and famine too
I will make you a horror to the earth
Because you broke the covenant in your birth

[Bridge]
Like the calf they cut in two and walked through
The priests and the leaders broke the law and broke the vow
Their corpses will be food for birds in the sky
And the beasts of the earth under the eye

[Outro]
I will bring them back to this city of stone
To fight and to capture and to burn their home
